description: Build a slim CI dev shell (buck2, tk, python3, language toolchains + cells; no turnkey-composed, jj, beadwork, mdbook), push its cells to Cachix, and add an ubuntu-latest job that runs src/cmd/check-test-runner-parity when nix/buck2/buck2-source.nix or the test runner changes. Facts: docs/research/parity-suite-ci-gate.md on bookmark research/parity-suite-ci-gate (turnkey-luk.2). Ruled out of the buck2-bundling map turnkey-luk by turnkey-luk.8.
title: CI gate: run the test-runner parity suite in a slim CI shell
